findings.title: Reflected XSS via name parameter — filter bypass using string concatenation
findings.description: The /page endpoint reflects the `name` GET parameter directly into the HTML body without sufficient sanitization. The server blocks the literal string 'alert', but this filter is trivially bypassed by splitting the function name via JavaScript string concatenation: window['al'+'ert']('XSS'). The X-XSS-Protection header is explicitly set to 0, confirming the challenge is designed for client-side exploitation.
